WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS BIGINT) AS salespersonid, 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS year, 
        SUM(TRY_CAST(subtotal AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales 
    FROM adventureworks.main.salesorderheader 
    WHERE TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY salespersonid, year
),
quotas AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS BIGINT) AS salespersonid, 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS year, 
        SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS total_quota 
    FROM adventureworks.main.SalesPersonQuotaHistory 
    GROUP BY salespersonid, year
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.salespersonid, q.salespersonid) AS salesperson,
    COALESCE(s.year, q.year) AS year,
    COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0) AS difference
FROM sales s
FULL OUTER JOIN quotas q ON s.salespersonid = q.salespersonid AND s.year = q.year
ORDER BY salesperson, year;

args.result_description: The table shows the difference between each salesperson's annual total sales (calculated from the subtotal of their orders) and their annual sales quota (summed from their quota history for the year). A negative difference indicates that the salesperson's total sales were below their quota for that year, while a positive difference indicates they exceeded their quota.
args.visualization_prompt: A grouped bar chart showing the difference between total sales and quota for each salesperson, grouped by year. Use salesperson on the x-axis, difference on the y-axis, and color by year.
